pchickey opened PR #14823 from pchickey:fix_ghsa_jxcf_main to bytecodealliance:main:

by changing the WasiHttpHooks::is_forbidden_header method to WasiHttpHooks::forbidden_header_filter, which is a boxed (arced) closure instead of a direct method. Embedders which customized WasiHttpHooks::is_forbidden_header must switch to using this new method in order to block trailers which are not the DEFAULT_FORBIDDEN_HEADERS.

Fixes GHSA-jxcf-8qw5-5c33
